# CANDIDATE: PULLBACK-HOLD-BULL-TRIGGER_LESS_LAGGING_QUALIFIERS

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** filter_change
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The PULLBACK-HOLD-BULL-TRIGGER uses two qualifiers: session-VWAP crossing and 60-bar market-structure trend to confirm an uptrend. These qualifiers may lag the actual pullback low anchor bar (J's 2026-07-22), causing delayed entries and missed edge. By replacing lagging qualifiers with less-lagging confirmation primitives (e.g., real-time VWAP deviation and shorter-term market structure), we aim to capture the move earlier without increasing false positives.

## Mechanism

Replace the session-VWAP crossing qualifier with a real-time VWAP deviation trigger: enter when the current bar's close is above the session VWAP (calculated up to the current bar) and the bar shows a bullish candle (close > open). Replace the 60-bar market-structure trend qualifier with a 20-bar market-structure trend (using higher highs and higher lows) or a combination of 10-bar and 20-bar trends to reduce lag. Entry occurs when both qualifiers are true and the pullback low condition is met (price at or near the day's low with bullish reversal cues).
